title: #12 Different Lifestyle
prompt: Some people work long hours to achieve success, but others feel that we should spend more free time for fun than for money. Which lifestyle do you prefer? Explain your opinion.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Working long hours helps people achieve success in their careers.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Working long hours helps people achieve success in their careers.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Spending more free time for fun is also important for a good life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Spending more free time for fun is also important for a good life.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Working hard is often seen as necessary for success, allowing people to earn money and live a comfortable life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Working hard is often seen as necessary for success, allowing people to earn money and live a comfortable life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Spending time on fun is beneficial because free time helps people feel happy, rested, and maintain better health.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Spending time on fun is beneficial because free time helps people feel happy, rested, and maintain better health.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Working long hours is seen as a path to success, as dedication to work can lead to great personal achievement, such as improving grades.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Working long hours is seen as a path to success, as dedication to work can lead to great personal achievement, such as improving grades.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: While leisure time is important for maintaining mental and physical health, taking breaks helps people recharge and return to work feeling refreshed and focused.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: While leisure time is important for maintaining mental and physical health, taking breaks helps people recharge and return to work feeling refreshed and focused.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Focusing solely on work and financial gain often leads to sacrificing personal time and causing exhaustion.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Focusing solely on work and financial gain often leads to sacrificing personal time and causing exhaustion.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Prioritizing leisure time is crucial because it allows people to rest, enjoy life, and improve mental health, leading to a more balanced existence.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Prioritizing leisure time is crucial because it allows people to rest, enjoy life, and improve mental health, leading to a more balanced existence.
